# Disagreements between financial practitioners

Recorded as found, without a verdict. Rules for both sides sit in this folder
so they can be tested on the same price series.

## Does a strong significator raise or lower the price?

- **Direct-strength reading.** A well-placed Jupiter supports gold: Tempora
  Research (Jupiter exalted in Cancer, and Jupiter in its own signs,
  https://www.tempora.ltd/findings/gold-jupiter); astrologicalmusings.com
  (Jupiter entering Virgo raises gold,
  https://astrologicalmusings.com/hindu-new-year-chart-2016-and-forecast-for-india/);
  Raymond Merriman for Jupiter in tropical Leo. Rules attributed to R.G. Krishnan
  are reported in the same direction, but no page by Krishnan was found
  (untraced, so not encoded).
- **Inverse (scarcity) reading.** *Vyapar Ratna* (Hardev Sharma Trivedi and
  Gopesh Kumar Ojha), as presented by AstroCapitalX
  (https://www.astrocapitalx.com/commodity-astrology): exaltation, own or
  friendly sign means abundance and a falling price (mandi); debilitation,
  enemy sign or combustion means scarcity and a rising price (teji).
- `vyapar_ratna_inverse_dignity_gold.yaml` and
  `tempora_jupiter_cancer_gold_peak.yaml` fire on the same days in 2026 and
  predict opposite directions.

## Is Virgo a good or a bad sign for gold?

- astrologicalmusings.com (2016): Jupiter entering Virgo raises gold.
- Tempora Research: the deepest gold drawdowns come with Jupiter in Gemini and
  Virgo (the same page also says Gemini and Capricorn).

## Sidereal or tropical?

Merriman, Gidel, Crawford and Gannpoint work in the tropical zodiac; Indian
practitioners in the sidereal (mostly Lahiri). Tempora's own-sign table lists
2019 as "Jupiter in Sagittarius", which is tropical; sidereally Jupiter was in
Scorpio for most of 2019, so the engine and the claim disagree on that case.
Tempora also dated the Cancer window from June 2025 (the tropical ingress);
in the engine's sidereal Lahiri positions Jupiter first enters Cancer in late
October 2025, returns to Gemini in December 2025 and re-enters Cancer in June
2026. Tempora later wrote that its entry date was off by about four months.

## Which NYSE chart?

10:30 LMT, McWhirter's 07:52 LMT, and the reported 10:10 and 08:52 variants;
see `CHARTS.md`. Dasha-based calls depend on the choice.

## Mercury retrograde: chaos or calm?

- Practitioners: choppy, false signals, stand aside (Merriman, Weekly Gold,
  https://www.astrodata.com/_productdetail/weeklygold_sample.pdf).
- Published studies differ: lower volatility in the US (Murgea 2016); lower
  returns attributed to investor belief across 48 countries (Wang et al., 2021
  working paper); an anomaly in Indian indices (Mahendra, Mohanty and
  Sudalaimuthu 2021, doi:10.1007/s10690-020-09310-8).

## Do eclipses move markets?

Arch Crawford links solar eclipses to hostilities and crashes; Larry Berman,
reviewing 13 US solar eclipses in the same article, found no relation
(https://www.bermanscall.com/behavioural-finance/can-solar-eclipse-affect-markets-look-financial-astrology/).
